files.evidence: Read in full (1 line; SHA-256 6c0e03d7a389f9aa539f7a5771555246bab2148d4f035ebbb9b65ad34f6dd173). This is a package-compatibility re-export of the reviewed root text-utils module and adds no code path or sink.

Read in full (781 lines; SHA-256 eca4ec48f4e442fd49de5653e7db815a18d934e633b75f35dd0505315fff60e7). Agent ids derive from trusted local configuration/environment and CLI filters only intersect that list, so no untrusted path/command boundary was established. Feature defects are concrete: captureAgent advances in-memory file offsets before embedding/table persistence and saves them even when all vectors/inserts fail (550-555, 635-742), permanently dropping those session records; its success return references block-scoped `items` outside the file loop (746), causing ReferenceError after state has been written. State also cannot recognize a rotated/replaced JSONL file whose size is <= its prior offset (557-560). Existing targeted tests cover exported stream/dedup helpers, not the full captureAgent failure/success path.

Read in full (96 lines; SHA-256 ee3ccfe02ee8b340b81328a9545bbc71bed9d6b02b6f115a29e04d9652c774fd). The operator-selected OPENCLAW_HOME is canonicalized, sources outside it and top-level symlinks are skipped, and copied symlinks are deleted from snapshots. It is a local operator CLI with no chat/request input.

Read in full (55 lines; SHA-256 ffa1238b1a8831dbe459ddf61eb8fe705928ebb4974932c2bb7dbaa16bfc372a). The workspace directory is an explicit local CLI argument and is passed to the code-index API; no untrusted remote caller, shell evaluation, or authorization boundary is present. --help executes successfully.

Read in full (145 lines; SHA-256 3cb133224e0b1ff87815160f8f70a6399b72b7a29a557af40657d1e5758815e4). cleanupWorkspace accepts a vault path, follows a symlinked records/tasks directory through existsSync/readdirSync, and unlinkSyncs matching target files at 112-121 without canonical containment, lstat, or a no-follow guard. The script is automatically invoked at gateway startup according to its header, making the mutable vault tree a relevant boundary.

rawCandidates.title: Gateway-start vault cleanup follows a task-directory symlink and deletes outside the workspace
rawCandidates.source: A user able to modify an Obsidian workspace can replace plur1bus/records/tasks with a symlink to another directory accessible to the plugin process.
rawCandidates.control: cleanupWorkspace uses lexical join/existsSync/readdirSync and does not canonicalize or reject a symlinked tasksDir before performing deletion.
rawCandidates.sink: unlinkSync(join(tasksDir, entry.name)) removes each matching missing-<field>-<id>.md file under the symlink-resolved destination (scripts/cleanup-vault-missing-tasks.mjs:112-121).
rawCandidates.impact: At gateway startup, an attacker-controlled vault symlink can redirect the privileged cleanup's deletion of predictable matching Markdown files outside the intended workspace.
rawCandidates.closestControl: Repository guidance requires resolveInside for file operations and rejects traversal; this cleanup imports resolve but applies no containment/symlink check. Existing entry.isFile checks apply only after traversing tasksDir.
rawCandidates.validationFacts: A bounded realistic-interface PoC should create a temporary workspace whose records/tasks is a symlink to a separate temporary directory containing a matching task file, invoke the script with PLUR1BUS_VAULTS, and confirm the outside file is removed. It should preserve all target source files.
rawCandidates.attackFacts: Requires filesystem write/symlink control in the configured vault and a gateway-start cleanup run; impact is limited to names matching the cleanup pattern. Preserve cleanup functionality by canonicalizing each path under a trusted workspace root and rejecting symlinked task directories before scanning/deleting.

notes: All five assigned files were read completely from immutable commit 6dff096efe936f7ec3d0e11a8ba83bf08671ad4e. tests/auto-capture-import.test.js and tests/auto-capture-batch.test.js passed; build-code-index --help passed. No repository source file was modified. The auto-capture defects are carried into the bug/feature audit as reliability findings, while the cleanup symlink path proceeds to security validation.
